item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.21
item.description: - The first paste into a brand-new, empty email in Mimestream or Mail now matches the email's font instead of coming in as plain text. (The empty email reports itself as a whole page, not a text field, and ConformTXT now checks it.) - ⌃⌘V can now swap back the first paste in a field too (the one where ConformTXT checks the font with its test letter). - When ⌃⌘V can't swap, History notes it once instead of on every press.
